journey.title: From bean to cup
journey.sub: How a real lot reaches your cup, from the farm to the bag
journey.step_1_desc: Farm, farmer, municipality and altitude recorded for each lot
journey.step_2_desc: Method documented: washed, honey or natural according to the lot profile
journey.step_3_desc: Roast curve, temperature and exact date. Within 15 days before your order
journey.step_4_desc: Packed with its lot code and details, from the farm to your hands
journey.curve_caption: Reference curve. The end point is the lot's real data.
journey.origin_photo: Ripe coffee cherries on the branch
journey.process_washed: Pulped and fermented, washed with clean water and sun-dried
journey.process_honey: Pulped and dried with part of the mucilage, which adds sweetness
journey.process_natural: Dried inside the whole cherry, which adds fruity notes
journey.process_other: Processing method recorded in the lot record
journey.cta_sub: Scan the code on your bag or enter the lot number and trace the complete journey of your coffee: the farm that grew it, the farmer behind the bean, the exact roast date and the quality control of your lot.

manifesto.label: Our philosophy
manifesto.quote: In Colombia, coffee is history accumulated in every bean. We are the bridge between those who grow it with care and those who enjoy it with intention.

why.title: Coffee with purpose, from farm to cup
why.qr_desc: Every bag includes a QR code documenting the farm, farmer, altitude and roast curve of the exact lot.
why.fresh_desc: We roast in small batches and ship within 15 days of roasting. Never warehouse coffee.
why.direct_desc: We work directly with Colombian farms. No middlemen: better price for the producer, better quality for you.
why.shipping_desc: Worldwide shipping available. Free on orders over $50 USD.
